regions.label: iNESHeader
regions.evidence: iNES header (NES<1A>, 8x16K PRG, 16x8K CHR, mapper 1, horizontal mirroring) per toolkit inspect

regions.label: CHR_ROM
regions.evidence: CHR ROM (16 x 8 KiB pattern banks) per iNES header; PPU-only storage, not CPU-addressable on MMC1 (SNROM-class) boards, so it cannot hold CPU code.

regions.label: ColdStart
regions.evidence: Observed instruction fetches only in artificial scenarios (RAM/register-edit warps to Blobolonia/caverns rooms; see analysis/scenarios.json); structure also supported by static recursive descent; natural reachability not established by these fetches. Context: 16K PRG bank 0 (8K banks 0,1) at $8000.
